findings.finding: Set BC=F_{n+2}, BD=F_n, CD=F_{n+1}. Let b−c=F_{n-1}. Parameterize b=m+F_{n-1}/2, c=m−F_{n-1}/2 (m>a/2). Compute geometry (A,I,F,E,N,K). Condition K,N,K′,B cyclic ⇔ circumcenter of BKN lies on EF → solve signed distance=0 for m. Ratio = (|CT|·NB)/(|BT|·NE) gives a_n. Numerically a_n→2+√5. So α=2+√5 ⇒ p=2,q=5 ⇒ floor(2^{5^2})=2^{25}=33 554 432 ⇒ mod 99991 = 57447. Pitfalls: use absolute lengths (BT may be negative), ensure m> a/2, solve signed distance root.

Scale BC so BD=1, CD=δ=F_{n+1}/F_n. Solve for r (inradius/BD) s.t. K,N,K′,B cyclic (use A‑mixtilinear incircle). Compute ratio R=|CT|·NB/(BT·NE). R→1 as n→∞, even n from below. Hence α=1 ⇒ p+√q=1 ⇒ p=1,q=0 ⇒ ⌊1^{0^1}⌋=1 ⇒ answer 1.
Use BD=Fₙ, CD=Fₙ₊₁ ⇒ BC=Fₙ₊₂, AF=AE=t, AB=Fₙ+t, AC=Fₙ₊₁+t. Compute geometry: N=intersection of line through D∥AI with EF; K=second intersect of (ABC) & (AEF); K′
